statements.t: Based primarily on third quarter occupancy carryover, additional marketing investments to bolster internal lead generation, and the expected revenue and expense impact of the recent fire at our 97-unit Clinton, Mississippi community, we are revising our 2026 guidance to Adjusted EBITDA of $495 million to $502 million and RevPAR growth of 7.4% to 7.9%.
The Company expects this transaction to reduce 2027 annual cash rent payments by approximately $17.8 million, and the lease would have otherwise matured in 2032.

We expect to continue to assess our financing alternatives periodically and access the capital markets opportunistically.
